m3_pre_registration.discipline: 若 ON 相对 OFF 未明显降低 turnover / 未改善 Replacement Payoff / 未提升成本后收益, v2.1.0 允许 Consolidation Gate 关闭; 不得为保留理念强行选阈值

consolidation_gate.scoring: consolidation_quality 0-100: sideway_days 分档(连续半开无空洞) + sideway_range 分档(小数单位 6%=0.06) + volume_ratio_5_20 + volume_compression_slope + volatility_compression; 权重固定 _W; px_ma60>0 硬前置 (M2-r2/r3 定稿, 见 portfolio/consolidation_gate.py)
consolidation_gate.params_notes: M2 冻结结论: min_quality=NULL 不选; M3 预注册三臂 {OFF,>=40,>=60} 状态机联调 (真实 promotion/replacement 事件 + event-OOS + 经济 Gate)

m3_result.finding: 三臂 (OFF/40/60) cost10: gate_off +0.7% / gate_40 -3.1% / gate_60 -1.3% vs Main5 +30.5%。Turnover 16.7→12.6→7.8, MDD 改善。**Replacement Payoff 为负**: gate_off 成功替换 14 次, challenger vs incumbent 20D -1.81% (pos 27%) / 40D -2.62% —— 替换门批准了错误的换仓, 被替换现任更优。gate_60 完全禁换 (accepted=0) 消除该损失但无正收益来源。
m3_result.gate_decision: 按 M3 预注册纪律: Gate ON 未提升成本后收益; Replacement Payoff 为负 (换仓本身不创造价值) -> v2.1.0 允许 Consolidation Gate 关闭 (Gate OFF +0.7% 最优但远逊 Main5)。min_quality 不冻结。Freeze 前置走 B': 冻结 Gate-OFF 配置进 M4/M5 评价 (2025+ Frozen 段未被调参触碰)。
m3_r2_fixes: Gate#4 实际 weight_delta (1/当日CORE池) + design_fixed 常数全量入 DRAFT
真实 Replacement Payoff 20/40D challenger-incumbent (purge 后窗口)
